description: Research Experience for Undergraduates (REU), NHERI 2025: Heat Flux in an Enclosed Cold-Formed Steel Compartment is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by David Kroeker, California Polytechnic State University San Luis Obispo (calpoly.edu). This project aimed to quantify the heat flux of compartment fires in a cold-formed steel building. The data gathered can be compared to future tests and further analyzed to further current modeling systems. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 4 top-level files (PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-neww-9934. Keywords: LHPOST6,  University of California San Diego,  CFS-10,  Live-Fire,  Heat Flux,  Post Seismic Fire. Published 2025-09-02. Facility named: Six Degree of Freedom Large High-Performance Outdoor Shake Table (LHPOST6) - University of California, San Diego. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
